verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Lovable generates a working app via chat with an editable, real-time preview (implied by Build mode's live execution, follow-up steering mid-task, and drafts each with 'their own chat and preview') before a separate explicit publish step. However, there's no dedicated documentation describing the live preview UI/interaction itself (e.g., viewing on different devices, direct preview editing) beyond inference from agent-mode and draft descriptions, and community evidence doesn't corroborate the pre-publish preview experience specifically. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the live preview interface/interaction itself, independent hands-on confirmation of pre-publish preview usability, and detail on how preview differs from published state.
